# Subway Seat for Tailwind CSS

Tailwind v4 theme files add ss-* colours (bg-ss-base, text-ss-orange) for one flavor. For v3, subway-seat-preset.js has all three as ss-walnut-*, ss-tunnel-* and ss-enamel-*.

[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/tailwind/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.css`](subway-seat.css) | next to your main CSS file |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.css`](subway-seat-tunnel.css) | next to your main CSS file |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.css`](subway-seat-enamel.css) | next to your main CSS file |
| All three | [`subway-seat-preset.js`](subway-seat-preset.js) | your project root, next to tailwind.config.js |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your main CSS file (Tailwind v4):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "./subway-seat.css";

/* bg-ss-base text-ss-text border-ss-surface1 text-ss-orange */
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your main CSS file (Tailwind v4):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "./subway-seat-tunnel.css";

/* bg-ss-base text-ss-text border-ss-surface1 text-ss-orange */
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your main CSS file (Tailwind v4):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "./subway-seat-enamel.css";

/* bg-ss-base text-ss-text border-ss-surface1 text-ss-orange */
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
